issue_context.title: Feature: Start a search when clicking tags in the details layout
issue_context.body:
### What feature or improvement do you think would benefit Files?

Clicking a tag in the details layout should start a search in the folder for other items with the tag.

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/39923744/217665804-44535387-680e-4597-83ca-7fd41eceedd2.png)


### Requirements

- Clicking a tag in the details layout should start a search for other items in the same directory that have the tag.

### Files Version

2.4.31.0

### Windows Version

10.0.25290.1010

### Comments

_No response_
